metadata.title: Curated Public Data Centre Facilities in India
metadata.coverageNotice: Dataset incomplete: Curated subset of major hyperscale and enterprise facilities from verified public announcements, corporate filings, and industry registries. It is not an exhaustive census of all data centres across India.

statusDefinitions.Operational: Facility is live and actively delivering commissioned power to IT payloads.
statusDefinitions.Under Construction: Civil structure or MEP fit-out in progress with published target commissioning dates.
statusDefinitions.Planned: Land acquired or official MoUs signed with state governments; site not yet commissioned.

facilities.name: Yotta NM1 (Panvel Campus)
facilities.address: Integrated Yotta Data Center Park, Hiranandani Fortune City, Panvel, Navi Mumbai 410221
facilities.sourceTitle: Yotta NM1 Uptime Institute Tier IV Certification & Public Launch
facilities.notes: First building in the planned 5-building, 250 MW campus. Operational since July 2020.

facilities.name: Yotta D1 (Greater Noida)
facilities.address: Plot No 7, Tusiana Village, Knowledge Park V, Greater Noida 201301
facilities.sourceTitle: Yotta D1 North India Hyperscale Launch Announcement (Oct 2022)
facilities.notes: First of 6 buildings planned on the 20-acre Greater Noida campus (160 MW total IT power planned).

facilities.name: CtrlS Mumbai DC-2 (Mahape)
facilities.address: TTC Industrial Area, MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai 400710
facilities.notes: Rated Tier-4 datacenter facility in TTC Industrial corridor.

facilities.name: CtrlS Hyderabad DC-1 (HITEC City)
facilities.address: HITEC City Phase II, Madhapur, Hyderabad 500081
facilities.notes: Flagship operational colocation facility in Telangana's IT corridor.

facilities.name: CtrlS Bengaluru DC-1
facilities.notes: Tier-4 datacenter in Electronics City cluster.

facilities.name: AdaniConneX Chennai 1
facilities.notes: Phase 1 operational of an ultimate 100 MW campus.

facilities.name: AdaniConneX Noida 1
facilities.notes: Major hyperscale campus under construction to serve NCR enterprise and cloud workloads.

facilities.name: NTT Mumbai 7 (Chandivali)
facilities.address: Chandivali Farm Road, Andheri East, Mumbai 400072
facilities.notes: Flagship building in NTT's Chandivali campus (largest single data centre campus in Mumbai).

facilities.name: Equinix MB2 Mumbai
facilities.sourceTitle: Equinix International Business Exchange (IBX) MB2 Data Sheet
facilities.notes: Acquired via GPX India; major network and cloud peering hub in India.

facilities.name: Sify Infinit Spaces Rabale DC
facilities.address: TTC Industrial Area, Rabale, Navi Mumbai 400701
facilities.notes: Includes solar/wind power purchase agreements through open access.

facilities.name: Yotta G1 (GIFT City)
facilities.sourceTitle: Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit MoU & Launch Briefing (Jan 2024)
facilities.notes: Designed for international financial services, low-latency trading, and AI compute.

facilities.name: Yotta Northeast Edge DC (Guwahati)
facilities.notes: Planned regional edge facility to serve North-East states and digital connectivity corridor.

gridContext.waterStress: High in interior Marathwada/Vidarbha; Coastal Konkan/Mumbai faces urban municipal rationing during summer
gridContext.waterSource: NITI Aayog Composite Water Management Index (CWMI)

Maharashtra.notes: India's largest datacenter concentration, centered on Navi Mumbai (Panvel, Airoli, Rabale, Mahape) and Chandivali.

gridContext.waterStress: Critical in western Yamuna basin; groundwater over-extracted in parts of Noida/Greater Noida
gridContext.waterSource: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) Dynamic Ground Water Resources 2023

Uttar Pradesh.notes: Rapidly growing hub around Noida and Greater Noida under UP Data Center Policy 2021.

gridContext.reShareProxy: 49.1% of state generation capacity (high wind and solar penetration)
gridContext.waterStress: Extremely high summer stress; desalination and tertiary treated water mandated for large industrial parks

Tamil Nadu.notes: Chennai is the primary subsea cable landing hub on India's eastern seaboard (Siruseri, Ambattur).

gridContext.waterStress: Semi-arid plateau; heavily reliant on Godavari/Krishna lift irrigation water supply networks
gridContext.waterSource: Telangana State Ground Water Department Annual Report 2023

Telangana.notes: Key inland datacenter hub with low seismic activity; major presence in Madhapur and Gachibowli.

gridContext.reShareProxy: 52.3% of state generation capacity (leading solar/wind producer)
gridContext.waterStress: Bengaluru metropolitan area experiences severe groundwater depletion and Cauvery water allocation limits

Karnataka.notes: Enterprise hub focused on IT and R&D computing (Whitefield, Electronics City, Devanahalli).

gridContext.reShareProxy: 47.6% of state generation capacity (leading solar/wind corridor in Kutch)
gridContext.waterStress: Arid to semi-arid; GIFT City utilizes Narmada canal treated utility grid

Gujarat.notes: Emerging hub for international financial data, subsea connectivity, and green power open-access.

gridContext.powerSource: CEA North Eastern Region Power Report 2024
gridContext.waterStress: Low annual scarcity (Brahmaputra basin), but high flood risk during monsoon season

Assam.notes: Pioneering regional edge facility for North-Eastern digital connectivity corridor.
